title.narrative: Strengthening Governance for Transparency and Accountability in the Belize Public Service

description.narrative: Strengthening Governance for Transparency and Accountability in Belize, is a 24-month initiative designed to address the critical challenges undermining governance in Belize. By adopting a two-pronged approach, the project aims to implement a range of interventions focused on building the capacity of public servants, civil society organizations (CSOs), academia, and media, as well as strengthening the Public Service Commissions (PSC) institutional capabilities to handle cases in contravention of the Public Service Regulations and the General Workers Regulations. These efforts intend to influence behavioural changes within the public service and establish a group of watchdogs to ensure the Government of Belize remains accountable to the citizens it serves. The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) will play a key role in contravening the multi-institution approach to educate and promote good governance intended to build greater comradery and a community of practice for key stakeholders beyond the 24-month timeframe.

participating-org.narrative: Good Governance Unit - Government of Belize

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
